clips.title: No hand
clips.instruction: Keep both hands completely outside the picture. Leave the background visible.

clips.title: Hold still
clips.instruction: Show one open palm in the middle of the picture. Rest your elbow on something and hold still.

clips.title: Move left
clips.instruction: Start with your palm in the center. Move slowly to YOUR left for the full recording. Keep the hand visible and at the same distance.

clips.title: Move right
clips.instruction: Start with your palm in the center. Move slowly to YOUR right for the full recording. Keep the hand visible and at the same distance.

clips.title: Move toward the camera
clips.instruction: Start at arm’s length. Move your open palm slowly toward the webcam. Keep the palm facing it; stop before it leaves the picture.

clips.title: Move away from the camera
clips.instruction: Start with your palm close enough to fill about half the picture. Move slowly away. Keep your palm facing the webcam.

clips.title: Move up
clips.instruction: Start in the lower half of the picture. Move slowly upward, keeping the same distance from the webcam.

clips.title: Move down
clips.instruction: Start in the upper half of the picture. Move slowly downward, keeping the same distance from the webcam.

clips.title: Rotate without approaching
clips.instruction: Keep your wrist in one place. Turn your palm slowly sideways and back, then tilt it up and down. This tests false depth motion.

clips.title: Partly hide your hand
clips.instruction: Hold your palm still. Use a mug or book to cover half of it for two seconds, then uncover it. Repeat once.

clips.title: Leave and return
clips.instruction: Show your palm for two seconds, remove it for two seconds, then bring it back and hold still.

clips.title: Move quickly
clips.instruction: Move your palm quickly left and right, then toward and away. Keep it in view as much as possible.
